title: TARGET-STATE CALIBRATION FRONTIER: identity-diversity sample complexity to identify subject-specific imagery-residual orientation
core_question: Minimum number of DISTINCT target-imagery identities to identify the subject-specific orientation of the otherwise-shared imagery component, such that the calibrated orientation generalizes to completely unseen stimulus identities.

claim_boundary.strongest_allowed_if_successful: A shared imagery-related representational component appears to require a measurable amount of subject-specific target-state calibration to identify its native orientation, after which the calibrated orientation generalizes to unseen stimulus identities.

v1_v3: optional descriptive only after primary seal

data.use_only: already-certified B0 Dataset-1 / O1-O2 data (NSD-Imagery vision+imagery betas)

calibration_budgets.unit: DISTINCT target-imagery IDENTITIES (identity-diversity sample complexity, NOT single-trial acquisition time)
calibration_budgets.imagery_repeats_used: all 8 valid imagery repeats per identity

balanced_subset_enumeration.rule: evaluate ALL balanced calibration subsets; average over all; no lucky-subset selection; no best-identity selection

frozen_perception_common_space.reuse: EXACT existing O2.3A dense-perception common space (vision scaling, W_target, selected K, training-subject common space, all vision-only alignment)

frozen_imagery_residual.definition: O2_2_IMAGERY_RESIDUAL relative to the historical SMALL visual span (immutable)

shared_residual_template.constructed_from: training subjects only via O2.3A common-space machinery; reuse frozen O2.3A residual-template rank procedure

zero_shot_baseline.M0: must reproduce existing O2.3A orientation prediction exactly (numerical/hash-level agreement within established tolerance)
zero_shot_baseline.name: P_ZERO

calibration_estimator.objective: Q* = argmin_Q ||X_C Q - Z_C||_F^2 s.t. Q^T Q = I
calibration_estimator.orientation_application: U_target = Q^T U_res; B_target = W_target U_target; Q_native = orth(B_target); P_CAL = Q_native Q_native^T

primary_metric.evaluate: per held-out identity, then average the two outer-test identities

oracle.R_NATIVE_ORACLE: training-only target-native orientation ceiling (10 target training identities; same frozen rank; evaluate on 2 held-out); NOT deployable
oracle.ORACLE_RECOVERY: (R_CAL(M)-R_CAL(0)) / max(R_NATIVE_ORACLE - R_CAL(0), eps); report clipped+unclipped; no >1 overclaim

calibration_null.destroys: IDENTITY CORRESPONDENCE (permute shared<->target identity mapping before Procrustes)

null_effect.E_M: mean(R_CAL_true - R_CAL_null_mean) after averaging (2 held-out identities, balanced subsets, 6 folds) WITHIN participant

inference.test: exact one-sided sign-flip over 2^8=256 configs per participant-level E_M

M_STAR_rule.definition: smallest preregistered M satisfying ALL: (A) median E_M>0; (B) >=6/8 participants E_M>0; (C) Holm-adjusted p<.05; (D) median DELTA_ZERO>0; (E) median oracle recovery>=0.50

primary_status_rules.TARGET_STATE_ORIENTATION_MODERATE_CALIBR: at least one primary ROI M_STAR <= 6 AND both show coherent positive calibration curves
primary_status_rules.TARGET_STATE_ORIENTATION_HIGH_CALIBRATIO: reliable recovery only at M=8 or M=10
primary_status_rules.TARGET_STATE_ORIENTATION_NOT_RECOVERED_B: even M=10 fails preregistered orientation criteria
primary_status_rules.TARGET_STATE_ORIENTATION_CALIBRATION_INC: numerical / data / leakage / provenance / measurement failures

mechanistic_cases.CASE1_sharp_M2_M4: low-dimensional subject-specific orientation estimable from little target-state info
mechanistic_cases.CASE2_gradual_M6_10: orientation partly shared but needs substantial subject-specific calibration
mechanistic_cases.CASE3_M10_weak: refutes 'missing rotation only'; not recoverable by simple orthogonal correction in vision-derived common space

secondary_parietal: identical analysis AFTER ventral/lateral sealed; cannot alter primary; interpret vs O2.2 parietal transport regime
optional_secondary_repeat_efficiency: NOT executed in O2.4; only if M_STAR finite may a NEXT gate vary imagery repeats/identity

prior_art_boundary.narrow_potential_novelty: prospectively quantified target-IMAGERY calibration frontier for recovering a subject-specific imagery-residual orientation, evaluated on completely unseen imagery identities

next_gate_logic.HIGH: reconsider practical value of a universal operator
next_gate_logic.NOT_RECOVERED: test whether a broader subject-specific transformation is warranted (do not auto-launch)
